# Interview P3: team lead for the accountants

Date: 2026-10-24. Remote call, 40 minutes.

She does fewer reconciliations herself now but reviews everyone's spreadsheets.

"Every month someone pastes a row twice and we only find it at review."

She thinks the hand copying is where most month-end mistakes come from.

"What I really want is an Excel file with our colours and formulas already in it."

She asked whether the export could be sent by email every Friday. She was not sure anyone would read it.

"If it saves each of them two hours a month, that is worth it to me."
